visual_observations.observation: A man is in a kitchen, chopping something on a blue cutting board. A woman in a black outfit and red hijab walks past him in the background.
The man opens a refrigerator, takes out a clear plastic pitcher with a purple lid.
The man opens the pitcher and drinks from it. The woman walks past him again in the background.
The man puts the lid back on the pitcher and places it on the counter.
The man is sitting on a wooden bench, playing with a small blue object. There is a small white trash can next to him and a container of colorful candies on the bench.
The woman walks into the frame from behind the man, looking at her phone. The man quickly puts the small blue object into the trash can and sits up straight, looking forward.
The woman walks past the man, still looking at her phone, and exits the frame. The man looks around with a slightly nervous or innocent expression.

hook_evidence.evidence: The text 'Wife Effect' appears immediately, setting up a comedic premise about a man's behavior changing when his wife is present or nearby.
